update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.73 - Archive Analytics, Race Strategy Presets, and OCR Reliability
Added ----- - Stats trend chart, CSV export, search/filter, and an in-app changelog viewer for the Career Runs and Legacy Parents archives in the Remote Log Viewer. - Per-race breakdown view in the archives. - Race strategy presets. - Configurable stop conditions for career runs.
Improved -------- - OCR auto-retry on misread (previously limited to training event recognition) now also covers training level, race name, and skill name/point recognition.
